scope: One controlled boot_a-only V33 trial under Noob's Linux-trial authorization. V33 derives from the hardware-booted V32 and changes only primary /init to reopen PID 1 standard descriptors before the Alpine guard. The stock kernel, supplementary payload and V32 bounded retry remain byte-for-byte identical. Other images remain under the general thermal hold.
required_before_write: Fresh Fastboot serial, product, unlocked slot A, partition size and download limit; exact V33/V19/stock hashes; offline validation; cool handset; ready pinned collector; exact V19 rollback.
required_after_reboot: Unplug USB, prove pinned SSH, start and verify V31 RAM health within the fresh-boot window, then arm Alpine only after the live guard passes. Observe PID 1, mounts, SSH, health and saved stdout/stderr. Stop on unexpected behavior.
abort_conditions: Unexpected identity, slot, write or reboot response; phone warming; charger connected during native boot; stale or failed health; unexplained SSH loss; unexpected recovery behavior; or a partial Alpine mount after refusal.
